stem: Which sentence can be added after sentence 29 to bring this story to a more effective closing?

options.label: A
options.text: Truthfully, that is just what I needed this time.

options.label: B
options.text: Thinking about gratitude helped to change my attitude.

options.label: C
options.text: Finding a new activity is a great idea for everyone.

options.label: D
options.text: I am really glad I have a great teacher in my leadership class.
